patchouli.gui.kubejs.sanity_curios.text: Players have a Sanity system. You can view your current Sanity by crafting a Sanity-Eroding Necklace
patchouli.gui.kubejs.sanity_curios: Sanity affects attack power, some accessory abilities, and a series of other factors. If a Sanity-damaging attack targets a creature without Sanity, it will not deal any damage
patchouli.gui.kubejs.sanity_curios.name: Sanity Value

item.kubejs.thlanium_bucket: Bucket of Dream Orchid Alloy Fluid
item.kubejs.starlight_mythril_bucket: Bucket of Starlight Mithril Alloy Fluid
item.kubejs.midnight_abyssal_bucket: Bucket of Abyssal Depths Alloy Fluid
item.kubejs.luteous_bucket: Bucket of Overflowing Color Alloy Fluid
item.kubejs.lustful_haze_alloy_bucket: Bucket of Lustful Haze Alloy Fluid
item.kubejs.dark_cryopla_bucket: Bucket of Eternal Night Alloy Fluid
item.kubejs.adamanite_bucket: Bucket of Infused Crimson Steel Fluid
trait.kubejs.pest_emperor.desc: Grants Defensive Pest effect over time, attacks inflict Infesting Pest
trait.kubejs.sea_serpent_scales.desc: Grants Defensive Pest effect over time, attacks inflict Infesting Pest
trait.kubejs.systemtime: Silence! Time is mine to allocate!
trait.kubejs.systemtime.desc: Attack damage varies with real-world time. At midnight (0:00) or noon (12:00), damage +75%. For every minute away from these times, the bonus decreases by 0.208% (reaches 0% after 6 hours)
trait.kubejs.glacial_state.desc: Attacks inflict the Glacial State effect
trait.kubejs.strange_crystal.desc: Each attack has a <Trait Level>x10% chance to plunder the target's essence. Successfully plundering triggers a cooldown of 3 seconds.
trait.kubejs.strikesoul.desc: Drops one essence upon killing a creature.
trait.kubejs.luminofish_ink_sac.desc: Attack consumes Trait Level×2 stacks of Poison effect, dealing magic damage based on the number of stacks consumed.
trait.kubejs.hallowed_ingot.desc: Every 30 seconds, gain immunity to the next attack.
trait.kubejs.shadow_snail_shell.desc: While sneaking: 85% damage reduction, but also 85% damage dealt reduction.
trait.silentgear.calamatium_ingot.desc: For each creature on fire within 5 blocks: Grants all players in range Health Boost [Trait Level + Number of Ignited Creatures] for 10 seconds.
trait.kubejs.gobber: May Your Journey Be Filled with Curses and Blessings I
trait.kubejs.gobber.desc: Attacks gain +10% multiplicative damage. Triggers synergy with other Gobber traits.
trait.kubejs.gobber_end: May Your Journey Be Filled with Curses and Blessings III
trait.kubejs.gobber_end.desc: Attacks gain +30% multiplicative damage. Triggers synergy with other Gobber traits.
trait.kubejs.gobber_nether: May Your Journey Be Filled with Curses and Blessings II
trait.kubejs.gobber_nether.desc: Attacks gain +20% multiplicative damage. Triggers synergy with other Gobber traits.
trait.kubejs.high_health.desc: Deals extra damage when attacking high-health enemies.
trait.kubejs.unstable_luminescence_ingot: Increases your healing received multiplier and armor value.
trait.silentgear.starinium_ingot.desc: Crimson spell power increased by [10x Trait Level]% when cast by the player, but each Crimson spell cast inflicts [Trait Level x3] points of Bleeding damage to the player.
trait.silentgear.eternal_starlight.desc: In the Starlight dimension: +10% melee damage per level. Outside the Starlight dimension: +10% attack speed per level.
trait.kubejs.neptunium_ingot.desc: Attacks have a chance to inflict Decay on enemies.
trait.kubejs.sleep_aid.desc: Upon waking, grants the player a Guardian effect.
trait.kubejs.exalted_beauty_gem.desc: (Effect Level × 2)% chance to consume 10 experience levels to completely negate damage.
trait.kubejs.boron_ingot.desc: Attacking enemies reduces their maximum health.
trait.kubejs.cosmos_aurora_ingot.desc: During rain: Spell attack power increased by [10x Trait Level]%. Increases player's Lightning spell power by [Trait Level]%.
trait.kubejs.fiery_tears.desc: Sanity ≥ 0: Gain Protection state, Attack -10%, 1 stack of Guardian, Fire Resistance, +10% Fire spell power. Sanity < 0: Gain Despair state, Attack +30%, periodic Blazing Strikes, Blazing attacks inflict [Trait Level × 10] levels of Burn, immunity to Seven Sins Erosion.
trait.kubejs.lacrima.desc: Sanity ≥ 0: Gain Protection state, Attack -20%, 1 stack of Guardian (Damage Reduction = stack %). Sanity < 0: Gain Despair state, Attack +30%, gain Vulnerability, immunity to Seven Sins Erosion.
trait.kubejs.twin_shadows.desc: Increases attack speed but reduces damage.
trait.kubejs.wip.desc: Due to production constraints, this material's trait is not fixed and may be removed or modified after updates. However, this does not mean only materials marked with this trait will be changed.
trait.kubejs.mana_quenching.desc: After casting a Blazing school spell, chance to restore mana.
trait.kubejs.meat_ingots.desc: Weapon every <6 - Trait Level> seconds: - Consumes <Trait Level>² durability - Attempts to heal the player (Durability consumed even at full health).
trait.kubejs.combustion_boost.desc: Hitting entities with Burn-type effects: 'Trait Level × 10%' chance to increase target's Burn level by 1. If target is on fire, extends the burning duration (up to 40 seconds max).
trait.kubejs.bribery.desc: When gifting villagers, restores some health and 1 Sanity, and grants 30 seconds of Hero of the Village.
trait.kubejs.comet_trait.desc: Arrow damage caused by you drops a falling star upon hitting an enemy.
trait.kubejs.monkey.desc: On ladders or vines, attacks add an extra arrow damage equal to half the current base damage value (excluding special effects).
trait.kubejs.vorant_ingot.desc: (Weapons/Tools only) Killing creatures permanently increases base damage and restores health. Killing players permanently increases final damage and restores health based on their max health. Lose some kill count on death.
trait.kubejs.demonite_ingot.desc: (Weapons/Tools only) Mining blocks accumulates energy, max <Trait Level> × 10000. With energy, mining restores health or saturation. When hit, consumes energy to reduce damage and convert to healing.
trait.kubejs.promotion.desc: When calculating trait level, increases your trait level by 1.
trait.kubejs.celeslar_ingot.desc: For each creature within 2 × <Trait Level> blocks, grants yourself 1 level of Damage Boost, up to 3 × <Trait Level> levels.
trait.kubejs.xelkive_ingot.desc: Every 15 - (Trait Level * 5) seconds, automatically removes one negative effect from yourself.
trait.kubejs.void_ingot.desc: Increases your invincibility frames after being hit. When your light level is lower than the target's, each trait level provides 10% extra damage per point of light difference, up to 150% extra damage.
trait.kubejs.echo_ingot.desc: Makes you immune to Darkness. Hitting a target inflicts <Trait Level> stacks of Slowness, <Trait Level> stacks of Paralysis, and <Trait Level>*2 stacks of Bleeding. Cooldown 15 seconds.
trait.kubejs.farmersdelight.desc: You are a farmer's son; you cannot kill whoever you want.
trait.kubejs.blazing_magic_set.desc: After casting a Blazing school spell: [Trait Level] × 20% chance to gain 1 stack of Blazing Magic (stacks up to 10).
trait.kubejs.arcane_ingot.desc: Increases damage based on your current mana, +1% damage per 10 mana, cap (Trait Level * 20)%. Reduces damage by 20% when mana is below 50.
trait.kubejs.knockback.desc: User movement speed reduced, but attacks pull enemies towards you. Pull strength: 1.0 + (0.5 × Effect Level).
trait.kubejs.cobalt_ingot.desc: Your mana cost is reduced by 14%.
trait.kubejs.lunium_nova_ingot.desc: You gain corresponding buffs/debuffs based on the current moon phase.
trait.kubejs.dragonskill.desc: Attacking dragon-type creatures adds 10 extra damage per hit, stacks up to 5 times.
trait.kubejs.dragonsteel_lightning_ingot: Attacks apply 1 stack of High Voltage. Attacking enemies with High Voltage deals 20 damage to nearby enemies without High Voltage and applies High Voltage to them. When High Voltage stacks reach a certain level, deals lightning damage and clears the stacks. Attacks inflict Bleeding. When target reaches 10 Bleeding stacks, consumes 8 stacks to grant the player a temporary (10s) Absorption effect.
trait.kubejs.dragonsteel_ice_ingot.desc: Attacks apply 1 stack of Freezing. At 10 stacks, freezes the enemy. Attacking a frozen enemy deals extra 20 Frost damage and thaws them. Attacks inflict Bleeding. When target reaches 10 Bleeding stacks, grants the player a temporary (10s) Absorption effect.
trait.kubejs.dragonsteel_fire_ingot.desc: Attacks apply 1 stack of Armor Break. When armor reaches zero, ignites the enemy for 60 seconds. Attacking an armor-broken, burning enemy deals significant magic damage and extinguishes the burn. Attacks inflict Bleeding. When target reaches 10 Bleeding stacks, consumes 8 stacks to grant the player 20 Golden Hearts.
trait.kubejs.polonium_ingot.desc: Attacking targets with Poison or Radiation effects applies Elemental Harmony.
trait.kubejs.radiance.desc: Attacks apply Irradiation. Higher trait levels apply additional debuffs.
trait.silentgear.acril_ingot.desc: Attack consumes 20 mana: Releases [Trait Level + 1] level Chain Lightning. Cooldown 10 seconds.
trait.silentgear.amns.desc: When typing 'amns' in chat: Randomly gain one vanilla effect.
trait.silentgear.ancient_metal_ingot.des: As sanity fluctuates, your attacks have a chance to drive targets insane, causing them to attack other creatures indiscriminately for a short time.
trait.silentgear.animated_steel_ingot.de: Per level of Sharpness: Adds extra (0.5 × level + 0.5) damage. Attacks have [Trait Level × 10%] chance to restore 1-3 durability.
trait.silentgear.aquamarine.desc: Randomly consumes 1-10 extra durability to increase this damage multiplier by 0.1.
trait.silentgear.arrow.desc: When hit by arrow damage: 10% chance to fully block. Blocking restores 10% health.
trait.silentgear.attack_taunt.desc: Damage -30%, but attacks have a chance to apply Taunt.
trait.silentgear.bismuthgems.desc: When attacking targets with armor below [Trait Level x4], deals extra 10 damage.
trait.silentgear.bloodjade_set.desc: Every 5 attacks: Deals damage equal to user's max health to the target, while deducting 50% of user's health.
trait.silentgear.carbonatite_ingot.desc: Sneak + Right-click weapon: Randomly gains 1 level of a random enchantment. Each enhancement consumes Current Level × 10% durability (minimum 1). Cannot enhance if insufficient durability.
trait.silentgear.citrine.desc: +1 Attack per 30 experience levels. Cap at 900 levels.
trait.kubejs.corroded.desc: Damage based on weapon durability: 20% Durability: Damage ×2. 20-50% Durability: Damage ×1.4. >50% Durability: No bonus.
trait.silentgear.cursium_ingot.desc: Periodically gain Ghost Form, but cannot use the Curse-Soul set revival effect.
trait.silentgear.dropped_experience.desc: Gain more experience from defeated enemies.
trait.silentgear.emerald.desc: Every 2 seconds: Consumes 4 durability of main-hand weapon to gain Hero of the Village.
trait.silentgear.enderman.desc: When eating, teleports randomly like an Enderman.
trait.silentgear.exalted_beauty_gem.desc: (Effect Level × 2)% chance to consume 10 experience levels to completely negate damage.
trait.silentgear.exp_to_death.desc: When receiving fatal damage: Consumes all experience levels to gain Absorption 'Experience Level' for 'Experience Level'/5 seconds.
trait.silentgear.frosted_helve.desc: The icy grip contains magical energy, increasing mana capacity and regeneration, and enhancing frost spell power.
trait.silentgear.garnet.desc: When ignited: Melee attacks launch [Trait Level+1] level Tracer. Cooldown 5 seconds. No mana cost.
trait.silentgear.gaze.desc: When staring at an entity, applies Gaze effect every 10 seconds.
trait.silentgear.gift_heaven.desc: When near death, consumes your Silent Gear weapon and negates the attack.
trait.silentgear.ignitium_ingot.desc: Your attacks inflict corresponding level of Blazing Gaze.
trait.silentgear.intrinsic.desc: +1% damage per 5 experience levels. Cap at 900 levels.
trait.silentgear.iridescence.desc: Damage randomly increased by [Trait Level]~[Trait Level+6] points.
trait.silentgear.ironwood_ingot.desc: Attack consumes 15 Sanity and casts Entangling Roots. Gain 80% damage reduction while casting. If Sanity insufficient: - Consumes 40% max health - Forces one root cast (can be toggled via key).
trait.silentgear.lacrima.desc: Sanity ≥ 0: Gain Protection state, Attack -20%, 1 stack of Guardian (Damage Reduction = stack %). Sanity < 0: Gain Despair state, Attack +30%, gain Vulnerability, immunity to Seven Sins Erosion.
trait.silentgear.life_drain.desc: Attacks grant yourself Fury Burns the Heart, reducing 2% health per second per stack. Attacks stack (max 5 stacks). At 5 stacks, that attack deals 300% damage.
trait.silentgear.luck.desc: Attacks have 10% × Effect Level chance to trigger, dealing extra (20 × level - Luck)% damage, minimum 5% damage bonus.
Scythe proficiency +35%. Soul System Enhancement: - Base Shield +20 - Recovery Rate +25% - Stability +20% - Essence Effect Power +25%. Attacks inflict Silence.
trait.silentgear.meat_ingots.desc: Weapon every <6 - Trait Level> seconds: - Consumes <Trait Level>² durability - Attempts to heal the player (Durability consumed even at full health).
trait.silentgear.mithril_ingot.desc: After taking damage: - Restores 50% of damage as health - Deducts Recovery × 10 mana (fails if insufficient mana).
trait.silentgear.moonstone.desc: Day: Attack damage reduced 10%/level. Night: Attacks add 2 + 2/level magic damage.
trait.silentgear.multicolor.desc: Attacks randomly apply one negative effect: Weakness, Slowness, Wither, Bleeding.
trait.silentgear.naughty.desc: When holding any weapon of Trash quality, each attack has a 0.005% chance to fully restore the holder's health and negate the attack's damage.
trait.silentgear.nightfall_spider_eye.de: Provides resistance to Glowing and Gaze effects.
trait.silentgear.overload.desc: When total number of Buffs and Debuffs exceeds 8: Immune to normal knockback, increases movement speed by 100x Trait Level%, triggers at the cost of 50% current health.
trait.silentgear.pearl.desc: Increases your Luck, but when injured, gain Bad Luck.
trait.kubejs.prismarine_crystals.desc: When in water, gain Conduit Power.
trait.silentgear.set_numbness.desc: On hit: Target gains 1.5 seconds 'Current Overflow'. Self gains 3 seconds Speed I.
trait.silentgear.set_ponder.desc: Attacks inflict Deep Thought on the target, effect depends on trait level.
trait.silentgear.shivering_gel.desc: Every 5 seconds, applies 2 stacks of Slowness to units within 5 blocks with Tremor strength ≥ 10.
trait.silentgear.six_life_death_set.desc: Each attack adds 1 stack of 'Death Omen' to target. At 36 stacks: Consumes 5% of own health, deals Consumed Health × 5 void damage to target.
trait.kubejs.spell_level_up.desc: When casting spells: Spell Level +2, but mana cost +50.
trait.silentgear.spinel.desc: Continuously gain Strength [Trait Level + 1], but attacks have 20% chance to be nullified.
trait.silentgear.strip.desc: When attacking full-health targets, deals extra [Trait Level + 5] damage.
trait.silentgear.systemtime: Quiet! Time is mine to allocate!
trait.silentgear.systemtime.desc: Attack damage varies based on real-world time. At midnight (0:00) or noon (12:00): Damage +75%. For each minute away from these times, bonus decreases by 0.208% (down to 0% after 6 hours).
trait.silentgear.tanzanite.desc: Attacks randomly apply one negative effect [Slowness, Weakness, Mining Fatigue, Nausea, Blindness, Wither, Poison, Darkness, Bleeding]. Duration: Level × 5 seconds. Strength: Level - 1.
trait.silentgear.tooth_of_hunger.desc: Each attack consumes (Level + 1) hunger and increases damage. When full, may accidentally injure self. When hungry, more likely to bite enemies and restore (Level + 1) hunger. When starving: 40% chance to self-inflict 1 damage. Effect strengthens with trait level.
trait.silentgear.topaz.desc: If weapon's remaining durability is a multiple of 12, attacks deal extra damage, +10 damage per effect level.
trait.silentgear.amber.desc: When injured: [Trait Level × 10%] chance to gain Strength III + Speed III (5 seconds).
trait.silentgear.void_ingot.desc: Increases your invincibility frames after being hit.
trait.silentgear.wither_howitzer.desc: Gain 1 Wither Dart every 20 seconds (max 8). Use weapon skill key: - Consumes 1 to propel yourself - Gain Speed II for 3 seconds. When attacking: - Consumes 1 dart to cause heavy knockback - Deals extra 20% damage (multiplicative).
trait.silentgear.witherbone.desc: When attacking any entity: Self gains damage boost based on target's Wither stacks and regeneration effect.
trait.silentgear.wolf.desc: Each time you are injured, summons a tamed wolf.
trait.silentgear.fluxing.desc: Against burning/lava enemies: Deals 1 + (0.2 × Level) times damage.
trait.silentgear.tenacious_vine.desc: When hit, releases Moonlight Thorns that slow enemies.
trait.silentgear.soul_dew.desc: Increases essence acquisition efficiency and enhances scythe proficiency.
trait.silentgear.atalphaite.desc: Attacks deal base damage +25% and cause small area spread (spread damage 50%). Spread damage continues spreading (damage reduced 50% each spread).
trait.silentgear.wind_blast.desc: Attacks release a strong wind blast.
trait.silentgear.lunium_nova.desc: Increases your soul shield capacity and recovery rate.
trait.silentgear.xeproda.desc: Entities you stare at are periodically inflicted with Gaze.
trait.silentgear.hallowed_gold_ingot.des: Enhances scythe proficiency and increases Holy spell power.
trait.silentgear.golem_steel_ingot.desc: Increases your draw speed and projectile damage.
trait.silentgear.soul_stained_steel_ingo: Enhances scythe proficiency, increases soul shield capacity, recovery rate, and the extra strength of effects triggered when collecting essence.
trait.silentgear.fortunate.desc: Mining blocks drops extra items, similar to Fortune enchantment (does not stack with enchantment).
trait.silentgear.thermal_springstone_ing: On attack: Ignites target for 3 seconds. If target already burning: Deals 15% × Level extra damage. When self burning: Adds 1/3 original damage as fire damage.
trait.silentgear.malarite.desc: Your attacks inflict Poison. If target already has Poison, grants self Trait Level*2 seconds / Trait Level of Spider Toxin Phase.
trait.silentgear.heat_resistant.desc: Reduces fire damage. Item cannot be destroyed by fire or lava.
trait.silentgear.combustion_boost.desc: Your attacks extend the burning duration of targets.
trait.silentgear.swamp_silver_ingot.desc: Makes you immune to specific potion effects.
trait.silentgear.aethersent_ingot.desc: When injured, releases a meteor shower to attack your enemies.
trait.silentgear.achroous_ingot: I Can Count to Ten on One Hand
trait.silentgear.achroous_ingot.desc: Attack speed increased by [Trait Level / 2], but each attack has [Trait Level x 10%] chance to inflict 5 magic damage to user and cause Nausea 1 + Weakness 1 for 3 seconds every 5 seconds to creatures within 5 blocks.
You have a 1% chance to deal 300% of current weapon's damage to enemies.
trait.silentgear.max_health.desc: Your attacks deal 1/2/3% of target's current health as damage (cannot ignore damage caps).
trait.silentgear.magic_blood.desc: All your Crimson spell levels increased by 1/2/3. Unlearned Crimson spells become learned.
trait.silentgear.magic_ender.desc: All your Ender spell levels increased by 1/2/3. Unlearned Ender spells become learned.
trait.silentgear.magic_holy.desc: All your Holy spell levels increased by 1/2/3. Unlearned Holy spells become learned.
trait.silentgear.magic_lightning.desc: All your Lightning spell levels increased by 1/2/3. Unlearned Lightning spells become learned.
trait.silentgear.magic_ice.desc: All your Ice spell levels increased by 1/2/3. Unlearned Ice spells become learned.
trait.silentgear.magic_fire.desc: All your Fire spell levels increased by 1/2/3. Unlearned Fire spells become learned.
trait.silentgear.magic_nature.desc: All your Nature spell levels increased by 1/2/3. Unlearned Nature spells become learned.
trait.silentgear.magic_eldritch.desc: All your Eldritch spell levels increased by 1/2/3. Unlearned Eldritch spells become learned.
trait.silentgear.lucky.desc: When held, increases Luck value (Note: different from Fortune).
trait.kubejs.nlatstone_ingot.desc: When your light level is higher than the target's, each trait level provides 10% extra damage per point of light difference, up to 150% extra damage.

patchouli.gui.kubejs.kubejs_champion.att: $(#FFA500)Every 8 seconds, applies 3 seconds of 'Healing Blocked' to entities within 3 blocks.$(br)$(br)$(#000000)Placeholder
patchouli.gui.kubejs.kubejs_champion.rad: $(#FFA500)Attacks apply 5 seconds of 'Healing Blocked' to the target.$(br)$(br)$(#000000)Placeholder
patchouli.gui.kubejs.kubejs_champion.fir: $(#FFA500)Every 5 seconds, ignites nearby entities for 3 seconds.$(br)$(br)$(#000000)Placeholder
patchouli.gui.kubejs.kubejs_champion.san: $(#FFA500)If the player's Sanity is not positive (0 does not trigger), each attack inflicts Slowness and deals an extra 25$(ovo) damage.$(br)$(br)$(#000000)Placeholder
patchouli.gui.kubejs.kubejs_champion.no_: $(#FFA500)Each attack drains 100 mana from the player.$(br)$(br)$(#000000)Mana Black Hole
patchouli.gui.kubejs.kubejs_champion.sti: $(#FFA500)When attacking a player, if the player is not wearing Sticky Gloves and their main-hand item lacks Looting, forces the main-hand item to drop.$(br)$(br)$(#000000)Skilled at disarming enemies.
patchouli.gui.kubejs.kubejs_champion.cor: $(#FFA500)When hit by a player, damages 1$(ovo) durability of the attacker's main-hand durability-based equipment.$(br)$(br)$(#000000)Weapons rust rapidly in its presence.
patchouli.gui.kubejs.kubejs_champion.tra: $(#FFA500)Attacks apply 5 seconds of Tremor; weakened when blocking.$(br)Halved for non-Netherite monsters.$(br)Netherite monsters below 50$(ovo) health have a chance to transfer Tremor.$(br)Netherite monsters below 50$(ovo) health slow players within 6 blocks every 5 seconds.$(br)$(br)$(#000000)Endless tremors.
patchouli.gui.kubejs.kubejs_champion.lic: $(#FFA500)Attacks randomly apply a 5-second negative effect; increases level if already present.$(br)When healed, randomly gains a 5-second positive effect; increases level if already present.$(br)$(br)$(#000000)An undead mage proficient in curses and blessings.
patchouli.gui.kubejs.kubejs_champion.ref: $(#FFA500)When hit by a player, reflects 25$(ovo) damage to the attacker (capped at 15$(ovo) of the attacker's max health).$(br)If attacker's health is below 2 points, deals damage equal to current health + 1.$(br)$(br)$(#000000)Return the sender's way.
patchouli.gui.kubejs.kubejs_champion.par: $(#FFA500)Chance to fully block attacks based on the monster's Evasion rate.$(br)$(br)$(#000000)Skilled in defensive techniques.
patchouli.gui.kubejs.kubejs_champion.boo: $(#FFA500)Upon death, triggers a strength 2 explosion at the death location.$(br)$(br)$(#000000)Beware the final madness.
patchouli.gui.kubejs.kubejs_champion.sup: $(#FFA500)Attacks apply 10 seconds of Max Health Reduction; increases level if already present (max 5).$(br)$(br)$(#000000)Gradually weakens the enemy's vitality.
patchouli.gui.kubejs.kubejs_champion.fin: $(#FFA500)Attacks apply Burning to the target.$(br)30$(ovo) chance to add 60 seconds of Bleeding.$(br)Health < 35$(ovo): Burning replaced with Soulblaze.$(br)Health < 40$(ovo): Every 5 seconds, applies 10 seconds of Level 7 Max Health Reduction to targets within 6 blocks.$(br)Health < 40$(ovo): 15$(ovo) chance to apply 3 seconds of Divine Guidance to the target. Self gains 5 seconds of 100$(ovo) Vulnerability and restores 1$(ovo) max health.$(br)$(#000000)Master of the Primordial Flame; its attacks cause flames to stack continuously.
patchouli.gui.kubejs.kubejs_champion.ada: $(#FFA500)Consecutive attacks of the same damage type deal less damage, up to 50$(ovo) reduction.
patchouli.gui.kubejs.kubejs_champion.arc: $(#FFA500)Continuously fires homing ice projectiles that slow those hit.
patchouli.gui.kubejs.kubejs_champion.enk: $(#FFA500)Continuously fires homing fireballs, causing explosions and fire effects.
patchouli.gui.kubejs.kubejs_champion.liv: $(#FFA500)Regenerates health per second. Recovery increases when not attacking or chasing a target.
effect.kubejs.fear.description: Increases fall damage taken by the target and increases damage taken while airborne.

§aWhen Sanity recovers, recover an additional §bExcitement Stacks§r Sanity.
effect.kubejs.addiction.description:
Addiction value reaches §e8§r: §cNausea, Vomiting§r.
Reaches §e12§r: §cSevere sensory impairment§r.
Exceeds §e16§r: §4§lDeath§r.

§c- Addiction value over 16 is still fatal.§r
effect.kubejs.ignore_cooldown.descriptio:
While under this effect, you can §acast spells ignoring cooldowns§r (§eMax 5 times§r).
§6⚠ Cannot reset this effect's cooldown.§r
§6⚠ No recursive loops.§r
§0Damage reduction consists of two parts:
 §a 1. Time Reduction§0: More remaining time = higher reduction (at min level) §eUp to 40%.
 §0  - Decreases by §c0.5%§0 per tick.
 §0  - If effect lasts infinitely, uses §eMax Reduction Cap§0.
 §a 2. Level Bonus§0: Each effect level adds extra §e10%§0 reduction.
 §0 - Example: §bI +10%§0, §6II +20%§0, etc.
 §dFinal reduction capped at §e70%§0 (Time + Level stops at 70%).

effect.kubejs.pest_defense.description: When the user would be inflicted with (Burn, Bleed, Tremor, Vulnerable, Poison, Soulblaze) effect stacks, this effect instead reduces its own stacks by the inflicted amount, and the user is not subjected to those effects
effect.kubejs.pest_infesting.description: For each stack of this effect, max health is reduced by 1%. Every 10 seconds, the user takes (stacks × 3) points of gnawing damage
effect.kubejs.moon.description: You gain corresponding §dBuffs§r/§cDebuffs§r based on the current moon phase.
effect.kubejs.ignitium_ingot.description: Your attacks inflict §ecorresponding level§r of §cBlazing Gaze§r.

Inflicts Nausea 1 + Weakness 1 for 3 seconds every 5 seconds to creatures within 5 blocks.

effect.kubejs.exp_drop.description: WIP (Lazy for now, seems I wrote it once but lost the code).
effect.kubejs.luck.description: Attacks have 10% × Effect Level chance to trigger, dealing extra (20 × level - Luck)% damage, minimum 5% damage bonus.
effect.kubejs.morning_moodiness.descript: Attack multiplier increased to 1~10, but chance to roll 1 equals chance to roll above 1.
effect.kubejs.morning_moodiness_2.descri: Excessive fatigue is gradually emptying your mind...
effect.kubejs.damage_amplification.descr: Increases the effect holder's damage by 10% per level.
effect.kubejs.bleed.description: When attacking, immediately deals 2 × Current Bleed Level void damage to the effect holder, then reduces effect level to floor(original level × 2/3).
effect.kubejs.narrower.description: Makes you taller like bamboo, visual only, doesn't affect hitbox.
effect.kubejs.naughty.description: When holding any weapon of Trash quality, each attack has a 0.005% chance to fully restore the holder's health and negate the attack's damage.
effect.kubejs.overload.description: When total number of Buffs and Debuffs exceeds 8: Immune to normal knockback, increases movement speed by 100x Trait Level%. Triggers at the cost of 50% current health.
effect.kubejs.pearl.description: Increases your Luck, but when injured, gain Bad Luck.
effect.kubejs.pride_2.description: Excessive confidence will eventually lead to ruin...
effect.kubejs.prismarine_crystals.descri: While in water, gain Conduit Power.
effect.kubejs.sanity.description: Deals 25% extra damage when attacking players with Sanity > 0.
effect.kubejs.seraph.description: When not burning or in lava, gains 80% damage reduction.
effect.kubejs.numbness.description: Entities with this buff take an extra 10% damage.
effect.kubejs.ponder_up.description: Entity with this effect receives an upward thrust. Thrust strength increases with effect level.
effect.kubejs.ponder.description: Creature will randomly move a short distance in a direction every second.
effect.kubejs.six_life_death_set.descrip: Each attack adds 1 stack of 'Death Omen' to target. At 36 stacks: Consumes 5% of own health, deals Consumed Health × 5 void damage to target.
effect.kubejs.six_life_death.description: Triggers the Six Lives and Deaths Omen effect when stacks reach 36.
effect.kubejs.taunt.description: Forces hostile creatures within 8 blocks to attack the holder of this effect.
effect.kubejs.taunt_2.description: Makes the holder attack any attackable creature within 10 blocks indiscriminately.
effect.kubejs.no_adrenaline.description: You lose the boost of adrenaline due to fear.
effect.kubejs.vomit.description: Immediately reduces player's saturation, reduction strength scales with effect level.
effect.kubejs.wider.description: Makes you looked down upon, visual only, doesn't affect hitbox.
effect.kubejs.wrath_damage.description: Wrath's next attack will deal 200% damage to you.
effect.kubejs.melting_eyeball_ego_effect: [On Hit] Triggers target's tremor explosion, dealing 25 Sanity damage to the target.
effect.kubejs.hurt.description: Increases damage taken by 50% per level.
effect.kubejs.tremor.description: Movement speed reduced by 15%. If hit while having 'Tremor', gains 3 seconds of 50% Vulnerability and an extra 20% movement speed reduction for 1 second.
effect.kubejs.eye.description: While under this effect, 10% chance to not deal damage to entities with Gaze effect.
effect.kubejs.gaze.description: When staring at an entity, applies Gaze effect every 10 seconds.
effect.kubejs.rose.description: Potion effect given when attacked by Lust Erosion without Bleeding. Lust deals 10% increased damage to 'Rose' holders. At 5 stacks of 'Rose', being attacked removes all 'Rose' and gives Lust 1 stack of 'Damage Amplification'.
effect.kubejs.blood_rose.description: Potion effect given when attacked by Lust Erosion while bleeding. Lust deals 20% increased damage to 'Bloody Rose' holders. At 10 stacks of 'Bloody Rose', being attacked removes all 'Bloody Rose' and gives Lust 3 stacks of 'Damage Amplification'.
effect.kubejs.gluttony.description: Eating high-saturation food increases Nutrition value. Nutrition provides Gluttony with buffs and decreases by 1 per second. If Nutrition overflows, Gluttony gains corresponding level of 'Gluttony - Overload'.
effect.kubejs.sloth.description: Normal attack multiplier is 0~0.8; upon taking enough damage, gains 'Morning Grumpiness'; during 'Morning Grumpiness', attack multiplier increases to 1~10, chance to roll 1 equals chance to roll above 1.
effect.kubejs.envy.description: Your attacks randomly steal potion effects from attacked entities (stolen buff duration max 10 seconds, if less uses stolen duration), both positive and negative. Successfully stealing increases your damage by 3%, up to 200%.
effect.kubejs.life_drain.description: Attacks grant yourself Fury Burns the Heart, reducing 2% health per second per stack. Attacks stack (max 5 stacks). At 5 stacks, that attack deals 300% damage.
effect.kubejs.greed.description:
§7Greed is endless desire...§r

• Effect level slowly increases over time (+1 per 10 seconds)
• §cResets to 1 after being attacked§r

Each level provides:
• Mob special drop chance +5%
• Looting, Luck of the Sea, etc. +2 levels
• Experience orb and item pickup range +2 blocks
• Mining and kill experience gain +35%
• Spell scroll non-consumption chance +15%
effect.kubejs.lust.description: Lust deals 10% increased damage to entities with 'Rose', 20% increased to entities with 'Bloody Rose'. Lust attacks other entities to give 'Rose' effect. At 5 'Rose' stacks, consumes 5 stacks to gain 1 stack of Damage Amplification. If other entities have Bleeding, Lust gives 1 stack of 'Bloody Rose' to that entity. At 10 stacks, consumes 10 stacks to give Lust 3 stacks of Damage Amplification, and deals Bleeding damage to the other entity equal to its Bleeding level.
effect.kubejs.pride.description: Attack power greatly increased, but each attack reduces own attack speed. This debuff decays after stopping attacking for a while.
effect.kubejs.wrath.description: Wrath's attack multiplier is 1.2~2.0. If Wrath is attacked, gives the attacker 'Hatred Mark' and 'Glowing' effects. Wrath attacking a marked entity removes 'Hatred Mark' and 'Glowing' and deals 300% damage.
effect.kubejs.gold_body.description: When the user's health is full, cannot be killed in one hit.
effect.kubejs.eternal_life.description:
After being hit, calculates the percentage of health lost from this attack, and returns the same percentage damage to the attacker.
 Only calculates this instance of health loss.
 Damage to Boss entities is capped (max 2% of their max health).
effect.kubejs.rune_of_deflection.descrip: When attacked, reduces stack by 1, negates that attack's damage, and freezes the attacker.
effect.kubejs.one_six_seven_four.descrip: Upon receiving fatal damage, flips a coin based on Sanity. If heads, negates the damage and restores 10 health. Removes this effect upon triggering revival.
spell.hazennstuff.shooting_star.guide: Summons a series of blazing daggers above your head to attack your enemies.
spell.hazennstuff.fiery_dagger.guide: Summons a series of blazing daggers above your head to strike your enemies.
spell.hazennstuff.stellar_collapse.guide: Summons falling stars from the sky to attack your enemies.
spell.hazennstuff.terraprismic_barrage.g: Fires a series of prismatic projectiles to attack enemies.
spell.hazennstuff.call_forth_terraprisma:
Summons a Terra Prisma to fight for you.
'How can something be so ugly!'
spell.kubejs.plunder_spell.guide:
Attacks on other entities have a chance to make them drop their held item.§r
§7Drop chance is influenced by level and damage dealt.§r
§7Higher damage and damage share increase the chance.
spell.kubejs.eternal_life_spell.guide:
After being hit, calculates the percentage of health lost from this attack, and returns the same percentage damage to the attacker.
 Only calculates this instance of health loss.
 Damage to Boss entities is capped (max 2% of their max health).
spell.kubejs.explosion.guide: Launches a planet-destroying fireball, grants the player a duration of damage boost (duration increases with level). The first enemy hit gains 2 stacks of Contempt and Level 1 Glowing for 10 seconds.
spell.kubejs.demon_conch.guide:
Teleports you to the corresponding location in the Nether. Using the spell again teleports you back to the Overworld.
Teleport distance corresponds to spell level.
'You always feel like you'll get stuck in a wall doing this.'
spell.kubejs.fire_arrow.guide: Fires three flash bombs forward. Number of salvos increases with spell level.
spell.kubejs.clear_cooldown.guide: Grants yourself the Impending Day effect. While under this effect, you can cast spells ignoring cooldowns (cannot reset Impending Day's own cooldown, no recursive loops).
spell.kubejs.rune_of_deflection.guide: When attacked, reduces stack by 1, negates that attack's damage, and freezes the attacker.
spell.kubejs.gold_body.guide: When the user's health is full, cannot be killed in one hit.
spell.kubejs.phantom_pain.guide: Summons multiple star rings to volley comets at the target. Number of rings and comets increases with spell level and spell power.
spell.kubejs.one_six_seven_four.guide: Upon receiving fatal damage, flips a coin based on Sanity. If heads, negates the damage and restores 10 health. Removes this effect upon triggering revival.
spell.kubejs.explosion.description: Summons and launches a planet-destroying fireball with intense energy, exploding upon contact.
spell.kubejs.fire_arrow.desc: Fires multiple fire arrows in a fan shape.
spell.hazennstuff.chaotic_teleport.guide: Attempts to teleport the player in the direction they are looking, and grants the player 'Chaotic State' for a duration.

first_kill_dead_king.message.a: The tremor of runes shakes the abyss, ancient whispers awaken within the veins
first_kill_dead_king.message.b: The dissipating might is seeking a new vessel...
first_kill_fire_boss.message.a: The heat in the air has not dissipated; after the fury, an abnormal calm...
first_kill_ender_guardian.message.a: The surrounding whispers discuss an evolution...
first_kill_skeletron.message.a: Newly formed minerals have coalesced underground
message.wits.desc: You are currently within the following structure:
message.sin.gluttony.message.0: Your digestive system begins to twist and deform, teeth sharpen...
message.sin.gluttony.message.1: Excessive saliva secretes in your mouth, everything before you looks... delicious...
message.sin.gluttony.message.2: A primal urge to eat dominates your thoughts
message.sin.gluttony.message.3: You suddenly understand the creatures maddened by food
message.sin.pride.message.0: A sense of superiority wells up; you feel nobler than everyone around you
message.sin.pride.message.1: You begin to look down upon all life forms, including your former self...
message.sin.pride.message.2: The colossal arrogance of the mind seems to crush the frailty of the body
message.sin.pride.message.3: You suddenly find others so... mediocre...
message.sin.wrath.message.0: A nameless rage suddenly surges; you want to destroy everything in sight
message.sin.wrath.message.1: The molten lava named Fury rushes through shattered blood vessels
message.sin.wrath.message.2: Countless violent scenes flash through your mind, each bringing pleasure
message.sin.wrath.message.3: Blood seems to boil, craving to see the pained expressions of enemies
message.sin.envy.message.0: You suddenly feel everything others have is better than what you hold
message.sin.envy.message.1: Pale green flames burn in colorless, deep pupils like dry wells
message.sin.envy.message.2: You begin scheming how to take what others cherish
message.sin.lust.message.0: The wrist that eagerly inflicts wounds is stained with the color of love
message.sin.lust.message.1: Rose roots have climbed the spine, blooming dew-filled buds between bones
message.sin.lust.message.2: Blood droplets fall between fingers, blooming into bloody roses on the ground
message.sin.lust.message.3: Roses grow from wounds, each petal soaked in sweet, bloody desire
message.sin.sloth.message.0: An overwhelming fatigue suddenly strikes; even breathing becomes laborious
message.sin.sloth.message.1: You suddenly feel any action is meaningless; better to just lie down
message.sin.sloth.message.2: The body and limbs seem to have felt eternal weariness themselves
message.sin.sloth.message.3: Time seems to thicken, each second stretched infinitely long
message.sin.greed.message.0: Gold in thought cannot satisfy endless demands even for a moment
message.sin.greed.message.1: A voice inside says: 'More, I need more...'
message.sin.greed.message.2: Calculating how to maximize benefits at hand
message.sin.greed.message.3: The concept of sharing suddenly seems absurdly laughable
message.astages.herobrine_sanctuary.rest: §kH§r「You have not yet understood your duty in this place」§kH§r
message.soul_fading: You can feel your soul fading, your body growing weaker... Lost fragments: %1$s
message.depression.usage: Use /rf depression toggle to switch state
message.wendigo.usage: Type "/rf wendigosystem toggle" to switch state
message.sin_corruption.disabled: Cannot undergo sin erosion in current state
message.deathsystem.usage: Use "/rf deathsystem toggle" to switch system state
message.soul_healing: The soul's wounds begin to heal, weakness fading... Remaining missing: %1$s
message.sephirah.demotion.prefix: The path ahead seems still too cruel, better prepare fully in the safe zone...
message.sephirah.malchut.prefix: The adventure must continue, thorny roots have climbed the map.
message.sephirah.yesod.prefix: Powerful beings kneel at your feet, the lamp of balance has been extinguished.
message.sephirah.hod.prefix: The locks of order shatter as the creature before you falls, endless monsters descend with mad laughter.
message.sephirah.netzach.prefix: Children in darkness raise torches, dispelling nearby fiends, while distant black mist surges forward.
message.sephirah.tiphereth.prefix: Sheathe the sword, step forward and upward, entering a world never imagined.
message.sephirah.geburah.prefix: Raise a hand to brush away the clutter before the mirror, for the first time seeing clearly behind you.
message.sephirah.chesed.prefix: Shatter the monster destined to block the way, advancing further on the path of fate.
message.sephirah.binah.prefix: This dream is forged for you, this journey is because of you, the door before you willingly retreats.
message.sephirah.cochma.prefix: Tables and chairs cleared, actors withdraw, on the empty stage, the drawn curtain welcomes the protagonist.
message.sephirah.kether.prefix: Reverie fades, the path forges the soul; in this world overrun by demons, tell me your truth.

attribute.aces_spell_utils.mana_steal.de:
Mana Steal
Steals a percentage of mana from the target and restores the same percentage of mana to the attacker.
attribute.aces_spell_utils.mana_rend.des:
Mana Rend
Deals extra percentage damage to the target based on its current mana. For every 100 mana the target has, the extra damage is proportionally reduced. Effect similar to Traitor's Ring.
attribute.aces_spell_utils.goliath_slaye:
Goliath Slayer
Deals extra percentage damage to boss-type entities. Implemented via tag system; entities correctly added to the c:bosses/ tag or aces_spell_utils:boss_like_entities tag are considered bosses.
Hunger Steal
Steals a percentage of hunger based on damage dealt to the entity. If the target is a player, reduces their saturation by the same amount.
attribute.aces_spell_utils.spell_res_pen:
Spell Resistance Penetration
Increases spell damage based on the attacker's Spell Penetration value and the victim's Spell Resistance value. The two values are added, multiplied by the original damage, and then added as extra damage to the base damage.
attribute.aces_spell_utils.evasive.desc:
Invincibility Frame Duration
Increases the invincibility frame duration after an entity is hit, determined by the attribute value.

entity.darkdoppelganger.dark_doppelgange: "The anger in your heartbeat, the resolve in your eyes... so familiar. Familiar enough to sicken me."
"Burn! You pitiful candle flame! Use all your light and heat to 'kill' me! And then... then burn on in my place, in this eternal cage!!"
"The brighter the light you hold, the deeper and more abyssal the shadow behind you becomes."
§5"The crown of shadows has found its new master."
item.darkdoppelganger.shadow_orb.tooltip: §5Your gaze completed its final puzzle. The illusion descended into reality because of your perception—this shadow core is the invitation you personally handed out, summoning the homage of ten thousand shadows.

§8"What he aimed to hook wasn't your life, but the very thought of you choosing to step into this place. The trap was already complete—the moment you understood the concept of 'trap,' all possible vigilance had become the sweetest bait sustaining its operation."
